capabilities: Ask GPT about a note's content and create a response note on the canvas
Generate follow-up questions about a canvas note
Create images from canvas notes via a context-menu action
Run system prompts on a folder of md and canvas files
Generate flashcards for the Spaced Repetition plugin
extras: Not available on the community plugin market yet; installation is via BRAT or manual download. Works only with OpenAI model gpt-4-1106-preview, and sent content can be inspected via a Debug output setting.
intentEvidence: A plugin for Obsidian that "augments" Obsidian Canvas with AI features.
problem: Obsidian Canvas has no built-in AI actions, so canvas users cannot query, expand, or interrogate their nodes with a language model.

relations.evidence: flashcards for you which can be revised using the Spaced Repetition plugin
rpggio/obsidian-chat-stream: Obsidian canvas plugin for using AI completion with threads
Quorafind/Obsidian-Collapse-Node: A node collapsing plugin for Canvas in Obsidian.

summary: Canvas AI helper that adds GPT actions to canvas notes, such as asking questions, generating questions, creating images, and making flashcards.
